sup:70610.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

It is always a pleasure to work with you, and we are delighted to present our proposal for your component requirements. As a reliable supply partner, we pride ourselves on delivering excellent service and maintaining a comprehensive product range to keep your production running smoothly. 

For the requested volume, we can offer you a price of €5.74 per unit. This quote comes with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We trust this proposal meets your expectations and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship. Please do not hesitate to reach out if you have any questions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

move.subject: Fastener kit consolidation — pricing and contract term
move.body:
Dear Mr Stadler,

Thank you for your quotation. Could you provide a breakdown of component, picking and delivery costs per kit, and identify savings from consolidated ordering?

Contract ctr:4600070610 records payment terms of 90 days; please retain that basis for the bundled agreement.

We propose €5.10 per kit with a 24-month commitment. Would extending the agreement to 36 months support €5.00 per kit? Both packages would retain the fixed enquiry terms.

Please indicate which package offers the strongest consolidation savings.

Kind regards,
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €5.58 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months.

Our colleagues will address your request for a cost breakdown separately.
The 36-month commitment offers the strongest consolidation savings, enabling us to reduce our price to €5.58 per kit.
We have incorporated your requested 90-day payment terms into this proposal to support the extended contract duration.
Alternatively, with a contract term of 36 months: €5.58 per unit.
Material accounts for about 61 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.

And while we are at it: our whole range is at your disposal, so if there is anything else on your list, just send it over - we are happy to quote.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

move.subject: Bundled kit: revised price proposals
move.body:
Dear Mr Stadler,

Thank you for retaining the payment basis; ctr:4600070610 specifies 90 days.

Your two packages currently carry the same price. Could you quantify the additional purchasing and handling savings available with a 36-month commitment? Are there lower-cost picking or packaging arrangements that preserve the specified kit and delivery terms?

We can improve our proposal to €5.18 per kit for 24 months, or €5.10 for 36 months, both at 90 days net. Please review these packages against the savings from placing the complete kit with your company.

Kind regards,
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.subject: Bundled kit: volume commitment and revised packages
move.body:
Dear Mr Stadler,

We can commit to the enquiry volume of 30,000 kits annually, including under a 36-month agreement. Could you obtain improved component purchasing prices against that commitment?

Contract ctr:4600070610 specifies 90-day payment terms; we propose retaining these.

We can increase our offer to €5.24 per kit for 24 months, or €5.18 for 36 months. The longer commitment would need a distinct price benefit. Could consolidated packaging reduce your picking costs while preserving the specified kit and five-day delivery terms?

Please review the attached alternatives with your purchasing team.

Kind regards,
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke
